resources.string: Swipe with two fingers to scroll
Plug it back in. It reconnects on its own — nothing to press.
Every key that was being held was let go, so nothing is stuck on the other side.
Your computer already has a phone connected — most likely the older OpenTrackpad on this one. Close that app and this one takes over.
Only one app can hold the connection, so this one waits rather than interrupting a session mid-gesture.
The two halves do not match
This app speaks a newer language than the OpenTrackpad on your computer. Update the computer side and it will connect again.
Until then the trackpad still works, without the rails. Tap to carry on that way.
Something is listening on the port but it is not the OpenTrackpad host. Check what else is using it on the computer.
Run adb reverse tcp:4242 tcp:4242 on the computer
